name: restore_snapshot
description: Restore a snapshot onto a new or existing branch. The call waits until the branch is ready. Pass `target_branch_id` to restore onto an existing branch; omit it to create one. Pass `finalize: false` then call `finalize_branch_restore` to swap names later.

finalize.description: Finalize immediately (move computes onto the restored branch). Defaults to true when restoring as a new branch and false when restoring onto an existing branch.

project_id.description: Required for an unscoped connection. May be omitted when the connection is scoped to one project; if provided, it must match that project.
